## Objective
The repository contains a single runnable Java program, `src/Main.java`, that prints a greeting to standard output.

## Interface
File `src/Main.java`, default package, containing `public class Main` with the standard entry point `public static void main(String[] args)`.

## Behavior
1. Running `Main` prints exactly the line `Hello, World!` followed by a newline to standard output.
2. The program exits with status 0 and prints nothing else.

## Invariants
Only the JDK standard library is used; no build tool, no package declaration.

## Edge cases
None.

## Guardrails
Do not add build files, tests or other sources. Do not touch any file other than `src/Main.java`.

## Out of scope
Build tooling (Maven/Gradle), tests, README, command-line arguments.
